name: Breadcrumb
description: A breadcrumb trail with chevron, slash, dot or arrow separators, an accent underline that sweeps in on hover, and long trails whose middle pages collapse into an animated ellipsis dropdown.
a11yNotes: Rendered as <nav aria-label> containing an ordered list; separators are aria-hidden presentation items. The last item carries aria-current="page". The ellipsis is a labelled button ('Show N more') with aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; its menu uses role=menu/menuitem, focuses the first item on open, supports ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End, closes on Escape (returning focus to the button), Tab and outside click. Hover/focus underline is decorative; reduced motion removes transitions.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.description: Pages from root to the current page; the last item is the current page.

propsApi.name: maxItems
propsApi.description: When the trail is longer, middle items collapse into an ellipsis menu (first item plus the last maxItems - 1 stay visible).

propsApi.name: showHomeIcon
propsApi.description: Show a home icon before the first label.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the hover underline and menu highlight.

propsApi.name: ariaLabel
propsApi.description: Accessible label of the nav landmark.

propsApi.name: onNavigate
propsApi.description: Called when a link is activated. Links with href '#' are not followed.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
